reason: The README describes a plugin for scheduling and managing standalone coding tasks that run in fresh Agent sessions with workspace boundaries and durable run history, making automation its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于创建和管理定时或一次性编码任务，并在指定工作区的新 Agent 会话中执行及查看运行记录。
summaries.en: Schedules and manages one-shot or recurring coding tasks, runs them in fresh Agent sessions within a specified workspace, and provides execution history.

capabilities: Schedules one-shot, interval, daily, and weekly coding tasks
Starts fresh Agent sessions for scheduled runs
Executes saved prompts within a selected workspace and permission mode
Supports read-only and workspace-write unattended operation
Provides web and Agent tools to create, update, run, pause, resume, list, and delete automations
Stores run status, summaries, errors, revisions, and result Session identifiers
